Quick ops checklist and AMI notes below — passing to Sophie once we validate formats.

AMI manifest / naming expectations:
- AMI name: <sellerid>-<product>-ami-<yyyyMM>-v<minor>  (example: 12345-acme-ai-ami-202808-v1)
- Required tags: SellerId, ProductCode, Version, Region, TrialType
- SellerId must match the Marketplace registration record or Private Offer won't bind

Billing / SKU mapping notes:
- For metered free tier: create a separate SKU ID that maps to usage dimension "inference_minutes"
- Tagging must include "trial:true" for automatic exemption in first billing window

Ops gaps we see today:
- Need a confirmed sellerid and AWS account number from Acme to populate the manifest
- AMI build must expose an endpoint that returns a health-check (for staging gating)

Attachments: ami_manifest.csv (csv), ops_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
